title: Early Childhood Studies Teacher Certification
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

outcomes: Understand and apply child development theories and principles.
Identify and implement observation, documentation and other assessment strategies.

Identify, develop and implement developmentally appropriate curriculum and teaching practices to positively guide children's behavior and learning. Value and cultivate collaborative family and community relationships.

missing_explained.why: not in the text; catalog lists CDEV C1000 Child Growth and Development (same title) in its place

notes: The certificate itself includes general education: the page prints 26 required ECS units plus 'General Education: 16-18 units' and 'Total : 42.0- 44.0'. The 26-unit core is recorded as total_units and the 42-44 total (with GE) as degree_total; a reviewer may prefer 42-44 as the certificate total.

GE requirement: 'General education courses must include minimally one course from each of the following categories: English/Language, Math or Science, Social Sciences, and Humanities.' No named pattern; the suggested sequence refers to AHC GE areas.
CDEV C1000 (Child Growth and Development) appears in place of closed-list ECS 100, likely a common course numbering change; recorded as a catalog addition.
ECS 149 is printed at 2.0 units (titled 'Cooperative Work Experience: Occupational'); the state file stores 1 unit.
The Suggested Course Sequence prints 'Total : 42.0- 48.0', differing from the requirements total of 42.0-44.0; the requirements total was used.
The third outcome line contains two sentences ('...learning. Value and cultivate collaborative family and community relationships.') printed as one bullet; kept as one entry as printed.
No career titles are named; the description mentions providing service in early care and education settings and the Child Development Permit Matrix Teacher Permit, which were not recorded as careers.
